title: 第2350章 强者齐聚黑域平原第2349章 再入黑域平原
content_zh:
火凤神皇主修火神道，性格暴躁无比，脖颈上的三颗头颅同时冒着火焰，中间的头颅开口道：“那我们就打！将他们都轰出去！得告诉他们，这黑域平原是我们的地盘，轮不到任何人来这里撒野！若是装作什么都没看到，只会有更多的人来这里。”
金龙神皇一身金色衣袍，金色的长发披散于身上，头上长着一对龙角，他皱眉道：“我们远古生灵，目前的天地永恒境，就只有我们二人，与他们硬拼，实在不明智！”
火凤神皇丝毫不惧，“我们比他们任何人都熟悉这里，甚至我们已经适应了这里的天地规则，能够发挥更强的实力，将他们逐一击破，并未不可能！”
“别忘了，若是让他们靠近了远古巢，影响了主上的闭关，或者让他们知道了主上的情况，很可能会给我们远古生灵带来极大的麻烦！”
一众远古生灵，都对来犯者，抱有极大的敌意。
原因也很简单，这些年来，被斩杀的远古生灵，并不少……
当然了，远古生灵也劫掠了很多过往的船舰，杀害了很多迷失在黑域平原的武者。
归根结底，双方都不可能是对的，互有极大的恩怨。
金龙神皇道：“这确实是个麻烦！”
火凤神皇心中有怒火，战意很浓，道：“我们一起出手，将他们都赶出去，顺带杀了最近这些日子，一直在斩杀我族人的那个小子！”
……
……
进入黑域平原之后，牧帆手中的大秦玉玺，所传出的感应只增不减，所以进入黑域平原之后的牧帆，不至于迷失了方向，准确的随着指引方向而走。
随着指引的方向前进即可，而并非漫无目的。
仅仅十多天的时间，牧帆便碰到了永恒境级别的强者。
而对方，竟是远古生灵。
是一尊乾坤永恒境级别的远古生灵，人类模样的打扮，名为元诡神尊。
远古生灵中，天地永恒境级别的，目前只有火凤神皇和金龙神皇，至于乾坤永恒境级别的，则是有数尊。
元诡神尊，正是其一。
“竟能感应到我的位置和气息，并精准的锁定我！”

牧帆感应到已经靠近过来的元诡神尊，眉头一皱。
不过，牧帆能通过对方的速度看得出来，元诡神尊的境界并没有多高，速度远不如自己。
但却能感应到牧帆的气息，并且锁定他的位置，这有些古怪。
为了查明原因，牧帆故意放慢了脚步。
不一会儿，元诡神尊便追了过来。
剑灵传音道：“看这气息，似乎是远古生灵……”
牧帆心中一怔，目光直盯着对方，试探性的开口：“没想到，黑域平原内的远古生灵，已经能够出动永恒境的存在了。”
元诡神尊冷笑一声，“知道就好！黑域平原是我们远古生灵的地盘，本尊的建议是，赶紧原路返回，离开这里！”
元诡神尊看出，牧帆的境界并不高，似乎不如自己，所以当然是显得很自信了。
得到确认，牧帆心中不由得好奇，现在的远古生灵，实力已经到了何种层次了？
远古巢的实力，或许已经远超想象，不亚于霸主世界的实力了……
content_en:
The Fire Phoenix Divine Emperor majored in Fire God Tao and had an extremely violent personality. The three heads on his neck were bursting with flames at the same time. The middle head said: "Then we will fight! Blow them all out! We must tell them that this black plain is our territory, and it is no one's turn to come here to run wild! If we pretend not to see anything, more people will come here."
The Golden Dragon God Emperor was dressed in golden robes, with long golden hair hanging around his body, and a pair of dragon horns on his head. He frowned and said: "We ancient creatures, there are only two of us in the eternal realm of heaven and earth. It is really unwise to fight with them head-on!"
The Fire Phoenix God Emperor was not afraid at all, "We are more familiar with this place than any of them. We have even adapted to the rules of the world here. It is not impossible to be able to exert stronger strength and defeat them one by one!"
"Don't forget, if they are allowed to get close to the ancient nest, affecting the Lord's retreat, or letting them know about the Lord's situation, it is likely to cause great trouble to us ancient creatures!"
All the ancient creatures are extremely hostile to the intruders.
The reason is also very simple. Over the years, many ancient creatures have been killed...
Of course, the ancient creatures also plundered many passing ships and killed many warriors who were lost in the Black Domain Plains.
In the final analysis, neither side can be right, and there is great grudge against each other.
The Golden Dragon God Emperor said: "This is indeed a trouble!"
The Fire Phoenix God Emperor was filled with anger and fighting spirit, and said: "Let's take action together, drive them all out, and kill the kid who has been killing my people in the past few days!"
…
…
After entering the Black Domain Plain, the response from the Great Qin Jade Seal in Mu Fan's hand only increased. Therefore, after entering the Black Domain Plain, Mu Fan would not lose his way and follow the guidance accurately.
Just move in the direction that leads you, rather than aimlessly.
In just over ten days, Mu Fan met a powerful person at the Eternal Realm level.
But the other party was actually an ancient creature.
It is an ancient creature at the level of the Qiankun Eternal Realm, dressed in human appearance, named Yuangui God Lord.
Among the ancient creatures, currently there are only the Fire Phoenix God Emperor and the Golden Dragon God Emperor who are at the Heaven and Earth Eternal Realm level. As for the Qian Kun Eternal Realm level, there are several.
Yuangui God Lord is one of them.
"It can actually sense my position and breath, and lock on me accurately!"
Mufan frowned when he sensed the approaching Lord Yuangui.
However, Mu Fan could tell from the opponent's speed that the realm of Yuangui Divine Lord was not that high, and his speed was far inferior to his own.
But it was a bit weird to be able to sense Mu Fan's aura and lock his position.
In order to find out the reason, Mufan deliberately slowed down.
After a while, Lord Yuangui chased after him.
The sword spirit said: "Look at this aura, it seems to be an ancient creature..."
Mu Fan was startled, stared at the other party, and said tentatively: "I didn't expect that the ancient creatures in the Black Domain Plains could already be in the Eternal Realm."
Lord Yuangui sneered, "It's good to know! The Black Domain Plain is the territory of our ancient creatures. My suggestion is to quickly return to the original route and leave here!"
Lord Yuangui saw that Mu Fan's level was not high and seemed not as good as his own, so of course he seemed very confident.
After receiving the confirmation, Mu Fan couldn't help but wonder, what level of strength had the ancient creatures reached now?
The strength of the ancient nest may have far exceeded imagination, and is no less than the strength of the Overlord World...
